content.short: Fully regulated, 1:1 USD redeemable, and built natively on Cardano for secure, transparent, and compliant digital payments.
content.description: Moneta USDM is Cardano's premier fiat-backed stablecoin. USDM is backed 1:1 by USD bank deposits and money market funds managed by Fidelity and Western Asset Management, ensuring stability and security for all users. Moneta Digital LLC , a US-regulated Money Services Business, is the legal issuer and redeemer of the USDM stablecoin on Cardano. Regulated by FinCEN at the federal level and by appropriate state governing bodies, Moneta ensures compliance and security in managing the USDM Reserve.
